Start writing here. Code is shown and messages/warnings are hidden by default
(see `posts/_metadata.yml`); override per cell with `#|` options.

Load data with [nflreadr](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com) (or
[nflreadpy](https://github.com/nflverse/nflreadpy) in Python) so that readers
can rerun your code:

```{r}
pbp <- nflreadr::load_pbp(2025)
```

Wide figures can use the full page width:

```{r}
#| label: fig-example
#| column: page
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Describe what the figure shows."

# plot code
```

To use a figure as the preview image on the home page, set `image:` above to a
file in this folder (for example one you save with `ggplot2::ggsave()`).
